language.note: Bolivia's 2009 constitution recognizes 37 official languages total (Spanish + 36 indigenous languages) — an unusually broad constitutional list, though only Quechua and Aymara have large speaker populations

terrainDescription.zh: 西部為安地斯高原（Altiplano），東部低地則轉為亞馬遜雨林邊緣與農業平原，地形高度差極大。
terrainDescription.en: The western Altiplano is high Andean plateau, while the eastern lowlands transition into Amazon rainforest fringe and agricultural plains — an extreme range of elevation within one country.

plate.color: white background, blue text (distinctive — not black)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Rare; white cylindrical bollards with either a red ring or red-and-yellow squares when present

utilityPole.transformerMount: Sign posts are often thick, unpainted wood; sign color/format is notably inconsistent nationally rather than following one standard

historicalContext.zh: 玻利維亞2009年憲法承認37種官方語言（西班牙語加36種原住民語言），數量在全球憲法中相當罕見，但實際上僅蓋丘亞語與艾馬拉語擁有大量使用人口；道路標誌色彩與格式全國不一致，並非採用單一標準。
historicalContext.en: Bolivia's 2009 constitution recognizes 37 official languages (Spanish plus 36 indigenous languages) — an unusually broad list by global constitutional standards, though only Quechua and Aymara have large speaker populations in practice. Road-sign color and format are notably inconsistent nationwide rather than following one unified standard.
